title: SCC Home Improvement Agency (HIA)
description: The service supports statutory requirements of the Care Act and Children's Act, particularly in relation to the prevention agenda. It aligns with the Better Care Fund (BCF) outcomes, such as enabling people to stay well, stay safe, and remain independent at home for longer. Additionally, it supports the BCF goal of providing people with the right care, in the right place, at the right time. The Care Act requires local authorities to ensure the safety and well-being of individuals in their homes.

title: SCC Handy Person (HP)
description: The HP service carries out basic (low-level) repairs, improvements, or adaptations to enable safety and independence at home. This service provides a range of interventions, including small repairs, the provision of handrails, and key safes. It also supports the prevention agenda and facilitates discharge from hospitals.

title: EEBC Town Hall Design, Strip Out and Construction - AWARD
description: This invitation to tender relates to the existing Epsom & Ewell owned site at 70 East Street, Epsom, Surrey KT17 1HB, which provides an opportunity to relocate the council offices to be fit for a future modern workplace. East Street would provide 60% of the existing Civic Office's space so a transition to more flexible and hybrid working will be crucial to a successful relocation.

description:
